_comment: 突變測試（StrykerJS）。預設關閉：不在 npm test 也不在每次 PR 的 CI 裡，手動 `npm run test:mutation` 才跑，或在 GitHub Actions 手動觸發 Mutation 工作流程。只突變純函式邏輯（規則引擎、管線缺口、儲存搬移、執行生命週期、雙語工具、頁首）；model.ts 與 finding-catalogue.ts 幾乎全是內容資料，不列入。 / Mutation testing (StrykerJS). Off by default: not part of npm test or the per-PR CI; run `npm run test:mutation` by hand or trigger the Mutation workflow manually. Only pure logic is mutated (rule engine, pipeline gaps, storage migration, run lifecycle, locale helpers, document head); model.ts and finding-catalogue.ts are almost all content data and are left out.

commandRunner.command: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/data/engine.test.ts src/data/pipeline-gaps.test.ts src/data/finding-catalogue.test.ts src/data/model.test.ts src/components/storage.test.ts src/components/harness-run.test.ts src/i18n/locale.test.ts src/document-head.test.ts
